caption:
Global Metadata: A fiery flamenco piece, 108 BPM, passionate E phrygian, with driving percussive energy. Centered on the flamenco guitar (Spanish guitar) with rapid rasgueado strums and sharp melodic runs, joined by rhythmic handclaps, a cajon (box drum), and a passionate male voice singing a dramatic flamenco vocal style. It opens with a solo guitar that builds intensity, the cajon and handclaps drive the rhythm, the voice enters with a passionate cry, the guitar plays a fast virtuosic solo, then the whole ensemble drives to a fiery peak and lands on a sharp decisive ending. Production profile: vivid, close flamenco recording, crisp percussive guitar attacks, warm resonant wood, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: One lead voice, a passionate, dramatic male flamenco singer with an intense, gritty, expressive tone, singing in Spanish. No falsetto, no backing choir, no spoken dialogue. The voice is central in the vocal sections and absent in the solo guitar passages.

Arrangement: Intro, a solo flamenco guitar builds intensity with rasgueado strums and sharp runs. Section one, the cajon and sharp handclaps drive the rhythm, the guitar keeps the fire. Section two, the passionate male voice enters with a dramatic flamenco cry over the driving guitar and percussion. Section three, a fast virtuosic guitar solo over percussion. Section four, the full ensemble drives to a fiery peak. Outro, a sharp decisive ending.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Solo flamenco guitar, rasgueado strums and sharp runs, building intensity

[Section 1]
Cajon and sharp handclaps drive the rhythm, guitar keeps the fire

[Section 2]
Ay, fuego en la noche
el corazón arde sin fin
un grito, una pasión
y la tierra tiembla aquí

[Section 3]
Fast virtuosic guitar solo over the percussion, no voice

[Section 4]
Full ensemble drives to a fiery peak, then a sharp decisive ending
